description: Brazil's general data protection law (Law 13.709/2018), in force since September 2020, with administrative sanctions since August 2021. It governs personal data in AI systems today.
Brazil's national data protection authority. It enforces the LGPD and the ECA Digital, lists AI among its priorities and would coordinate the SIA under PL 2338/2023.

The right to request review of decisions made solely by automated processing that affect a person's interests, including credit and personal profiles, and to receive information about the criteria used.
Relatório de Impacto à Proteção de Dados Pessoais: the LGPD's data protection impact report, expected for high-risk processing and on ANPD request.
Brazil's proposed AI legal framework: risk-based, with impact assessments, rights of affected people and the SIA. Passed the Senate in December 2024; pending in the Chamber, not law.
Law 15.211/2025, in force since March 2026: protections for children and adolescents in digital products, enforced by the ANPD.
